lines: The coach said Rodgers has been benched and released and will not play for Pittsburgh again, so his Wk 12 game against Denver looks off the table.
Before that, his passing dipped: 32.7 attempts per game over his last 3 games against 36.1 for the season, and 180.7 yards per game against 224.1.
The coach said earlier he would not single out Rodgers' play and put the offensive slump on the whole unit and himself. Rodgers had 16 total TDs this season.
